description:
Art style: one call restyles the whole scene (realistic, stylized, lowpoly, toon, retro, noir, ...).
A style drives three layers: global material switches for every builder material (MPC_RT_Style: flat shading,
procedural detail, colour steps, saturation, tint, rim light), a style post-process (M_PP_Style: toon bands, outlines,
painterly filter, pixelation, posterize, grading) plus post settings, and lighting (mood, sun, sky, fog).
Workflow: list_presets -> apply a preset -> screenshot -> apply again with only the layer to tweak -> define_preset to keep it.
Presets are data: built in, overridable/extendable from Config/RuntimeToolsets/StylePresets.json or define_preset.
See the art_style skill.
name: style

tools.description:
Restyles the whole scene: a preset and/or overrides of any layer, merged key by key. Without a preset, overrides tweak the style already applied. The material/post layer is one undo step; the lighting layer adds lighting undo steps.
Returns: The applied style and any lighting notes. Fails if the preset is unknown (the hint lists the presets) or the style assets are missing.

lighting.description: {mood, sun:{rotation, intensity, temperature, color}, sky:{intensity, color}, fog:{density, color, height_falloff}}. (Any JSON value)

material.description: {Faceted 0-1 flat shading, Pattern 0-1 procedural detail, Steps colour palette steps (0 off), Saturation, RimStrength, RimColor, Tint}, e.g. {"Saturation": 1.2}. (Any JSON value)

post.description: {Toon 0-1, Bands, ShadowFloor, Outline 0-1, OutlineWidth px, OutlineColor, DepthSens, NormalSens, Paint 0-1, PaintRadius, PaintScale, PixelSize px, Levels, Saturation, Contrast, Tint}, e.g. {"Outline": 0.6}. (Any JSON value)

preset.description: Preset name, e.g. "toon"; empty = tweak the current style.

settings.description: {bloom, vignette, ao, grain, chromatic, exposure_bias, temperature}. (Any JSON value)

tools.name: style.apply

returnValue.description: The applied style and any lighting notes. Fails if the preset is unknown (the hint lists the presets) or the style assets are missing.

applied.description: Whether a style is applied (get only; false = engine defaults).

lighting_notes.description: Problems while applying the lighting layer (missing sun or fog, ...), empty if none.

style.description: The style: {name, description, material:{...}, post:{...}, settings:{...}, lighting:{...}}. (Any JSON value)

returnValue.title: RuntimeStyleInfo

tools.description:
Adds or replaces a named style preset, optionally starting from another preset. Lasts until the game restarts (put permanent presets in Config/RuntimeToolsets/StylePresets.json).
Returns: The new preset. Fails if the name is empty or based_on is not a preset.

post.description: Post layer overrides, e.g. {"OutlineWidth": 3}. (Any JSON value)

tools.name: style.define_preset

returnValue.description: The new preset. Fails if the name is empty or based_on is not a preset.

applied.description: Whether a style is applied (get only; false = engine defaults).

lighting_notes.description: Problems while applying the lighting layer (missing sun or fog, ...), empty if none.

style.description: The style: {name, description, material:{...}, post:{...}, settings:{...}, lighting:{...}}. (Any JSON value)

returnValue.title: RuntimeStyleInfo

tools.description:
The style currently applied.
Returns: applied = false (and a note in style) when no style was applied, otherwise the style object.

returnValue.description: applied = false (and a note in style) when no style was applied, otherwise the style object.

lighting_notes.description: Problems while applying the lighting layer (missing sun or fog, ...), empty if none.

style.description: The style: {name, description, material:{...}, post:{...}, settings:{...}, lighting:{...}}. (Any JSON value)

returnValue.title: RuntimeStyleInfo

tools.description:
Lists the art style presets with descriptions, and every adjustable parameter per layer.
Returns: Presets sorted by name, and the layer parameter list.
tools.name: style.list_presets

returnValue.description: Presets sorted by name, and the layer parameter list.

name.description: Preset name to pass to style.apply, e.g. "toon".

returnValue.title: RuntimeStylePresetList
